name: Gaona Aero Material Co.,Ltd.
summary: Gaona Aero Material Co.,Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of high-end metal materials in China and internationally. The company offers metal raw materials, such as casting high-temperature alloy master alloy, titanium alloy master ingot; high temperature alloy powder; and high-temperature alloy plates, rods, wires, strips, and tubes. It also provides precision casting products, including high-temperature alloy precision casting, lightweight alloy precision casting, and bialloy casting; forged disc rings products; powder metallurgy products; and precision machining of disc and ring forgings.
